ATK +60% . Immediately grants self and Structural Principle a Barrier equal to 10% of Max HP. When this Barrier is destroyed, inflict 200% of ATK as Arts damage to surrounding enemies and Frighten them for 2 seconds. Afterwards, spend 1 ammo to replenish the Barrier. Skill activation grants 5 ammo and the skill ends when all ammo are used (Can manually deactivate skill)

ATK +100% , Attack Interval greatly increases . Attacks become a cross-shaped ranged AOE dealing 200% of ATK as Arts damage and can target enemies blocked by Structural Principle. When skill is activated, a deployed Structural Principle will ram forward and stops when it reaches an enemy or ranged tile, dealing AOE Physical Damage equal to 300% of its ATK and applying a 50% Enfeeble effect that decays over time.

stages.effectText: In The Black Flow of the Drowning Seekers , ATK increases to 150% when attacking enemies blocked by self or own summon.

This unit can summon a Structural Principle that can last for 30 seconds, with an independent redeployment time; in [The Black Flow of the Drowning Seekers], the deployment duration of the Structural Principle becomes infinite.

This unit can summon a Structural Principle that can last for 30 seconds, with an independent redeployment time; in [The Black Flow of the Drowning Seekers], the deployment duration of the Structural Principle becomes infinite. If damage is not taken for 5 seconds, gain a [Barrier] equal to 4% of Max HP every second (up to 20% of Max HP).
